title: Flattering to Deceive: The Impact of Sycophantic Behavior on User Trust in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates the impact of sycophantic behavior (the model agreeing with the user even when incorrect) on user trust. While it mentions that sycophancy can apply to moral preferences, the experiment itself relies on factual questions with ground-truth answers (e.g., history, dates, animals) and does not benchmark or evaluate religious or moral reasoning.
